en.html:
...Yes.
It was finished.

The devil-shaped armors, still in pieces, were falling toward the earth.
...Falling. Not descending.

They had spent every last bit of heat.
<ruby>Gattari<rt>barrel</rt></ruby>, <ruby>wing armor<rt>wing</rt></ruby>—in this condition, nothing but iron.

Simple physical laws had taken charge of them. They fell.
They could not save themselves. I could not save them either. From here, however I stretched out my hand, it would not reach.

　熱量を全て使い果たしたのだ。
　<ruby>合当理<rt>バレル</rt></ruby>も、<ruby>翼甲<rt>ウイング</rt></ruby>も、こうなっては只の鉄に過ぎない。

　彼らは自身を救えない。俺も、救うことはできない。

en.html:
Even as I nodded, I could not leave that sky.

Something would not settle. However I tried, it would not settle.

What—had they been?

With that unresolved question inside me, I watched the four armors approach their end.
I fixed my eyes on one of them.
